value.signature: fn from_value (v : & Value) -> Result < Version , EnvelopeError >

review.body: { let Value :: Array (array) = v else { return Err (EnvelopeError :: BadVersion) ; } ; match array . as_slice () { [Value :: Unsigned (major) , Value :: Unsigned (minor) , Value :: Unsigned (patch)] => Ok (Version :: new (* major , * minor , * patch)) , _ => Err (EnvelopeError :: BadVersion) , } }
review.item_premise: This body inherits the public-interchange decision for version::Version::from_value.
